input.prompt: Exactly 60 seconds of very understated ambient underscore for a real clinical research software demonstration. The emotional theme is quiet clinical focus, careful investigation, trust and thoughtful progress. Extremely sparse warm sustained synth chords, a soft muted felt-like note every few seconds, a very gentle slow pulse with no rhythmic beat. No drums, no percussion, no arpeggiator, no bass groove, no ticking clock, no dramatic builds, no risers, no trailer effects, no bright bells, no climax. Nearly motionless, intimate, calm and unobtrusive. Leave generous sonic space for a spoken female narrator. Low dynamic range, no sudden sound events. Begins softly from the first instant and finishes with a subtle warm resolution. Entirely instrumental, no voices.
